apps.localizedDescription:
The expense tracker that reads your orders for you. Connect the shops you already buy from, and Depensa reads your order history, so your spending adds up without typing in a single expense.

Sign in to a shop on its own page, inside the app. Your password never leaves your phone. The first time a shop is connected, an AI model reads its order pages once and writes a small recipe for finding your orders; after that Depensa checks for new orders with that recipe, with no AI involved.

- One total across every shop you connect, split by category or by shop
- The items in each order and what each one cost
- Subscriptions and other repeat charges, with the date each one is due next
- Monthly budgets for a category or a shop
- Amounts in other currencies converted to yours
- Your expenses as a spreadsheet by email

On iPhone, Depensa is unsigned: SideStore or AltStore signs it with your own Apple Account. A sideloaded install can't receive notifications and has no Sign in with Apple; sign in with your email or Google.

Privacy: https://depensa.techwithanirudh.com/privacy
